objective.note: The estimate was 280 lines; 233 production lines landed plus a 410-line suite — the mapping table (gix items to plain data) is the bulk of the module and every arm is reachable from the parity test. The reader was developed compile-probe style against the registry source: six rustc rounds, zero guessed APIs in the shipped code. max_func_loc/max_nesting null for .rs as always; reviewed by eye — the largest function (map_status_item) is ~55 lines, nesting <= 4.

summary: KEEP. Acceptance ① (no Git executable/filter in production): the reader is pinned gix =0.88.0 with default features off and status/revision/sha1 only; process filters are structurally impossible — no configuration section is trusted for filter drivers, so even a filter configured in the repository's own config reads as absent, and the malicious-filter test proves the reader never spawns anything while its control arm proves real git executes the same filter. The reader itself spawns nothing (guard stays green with no new allowlist entries). Acceptance ② (repository object not plugin-visible): the gix Repository handle is private behind plain-data types, the module lives under services with internal exposure only, and the crate root + plugin router are pinned never to mention it. Acceptance ③ (reads make zero metadata changes): the recursive .git fingerprint is byte-identical across status+log — no index write-back, no locks. P29.1 proven (canonical repo/common-dir only, external includes and alternates closed by isolated permissions + the HEAD-file signature), P29.2 proven (bounded status/log exposed; malicious process filters rejected never executed), P29.3 proven (fingerprint vs the separate-copy GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0 oracle — the oracle drives parity, the fingerprint drives immutability). Disclosed: the gateway's legacy git invocations remain the P24A guard's owned LEGACY entries — P30 wires them onto this reader; log order is walk-order (consumers sort); the env-injection proof runs in a child process (recorded test-isolation rule). House 1091/1090/1 with only the declared plan_schema baseline; the s07 and conversation_engine race members each appeared once across three runs and were green in isolation both times, all numbers reported.
